Name: Time Control
Author: Yousv
Description:
[center][color=#8e7cc3][size=6][b]Time Control[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=4]Time skip, stamina regen, time speed control, pause, menu auto-pause, multiplayer voting, per-minute clock[/size]
[line]
[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49186/49186-1784151561-420247646.jpg[/img][/center]
[line]
[center][color=#b4a7d6][b][size=6]Features[/size][/b][/color][/center]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Time Speed
[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff]Adjust global time speed from 0.1x to 10x. [/color][color=#b4a7d6](1.0 is normal, 2.0 is twice as fast, 0.5 is half speed)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Tick interval scales inversely with speed setting.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Time Skip[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Open a time picker menu while sitting on furniture to select a target time. [color=#b4a7d6](default: Ctrl+S)[/color][/*]
[*]The time picker supports controller navigation.[/*]
[*]Time skip passes time smoothly at a configurable rate, forward or backward, instead of jumping straight to the target.[/*]
[*]Rewind time to past times. [color=#b4a7d6](default: off)[/color][/*]
[*]Restrict skip access to host only or allow any player [color=#b4a7d6](default: any)[/color].[/*]
[*]Shows a notification with the skip hotkey when sitting down.[/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Sit Energy Regen[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Recover energy per second while sitting on furniture. [color=#b4a7d6](Configurable)[/color][/*]
[*]Energy regen during a skip scales with game time passed, so a time skip fills energy accordingly.[/*]
[*]Option to ignore global time speed when calculating regen rate.[/*]
[*]Option to continue regenerating while time is frozen. [color=#b4a7d6](default: on)[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Time Freeze[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Pause Requirement[/b] - [color=#b4a7d6]Any[/color]: pauses when any player needs it. [color=#b4a7d6]All[/color]: pauses only when all players need it. [color=#b4a7d6]Host[/color]: pauses only when host needs it.[/*]
[*][b]Pause in Menus[/b] - When enabled, time pauses when all players are in menus, fishing, or any action that would stop time in single player. When disabled, menus never pause time. [color=#b4a7d6](default: on)[/color][/*]
[*][b]Lock Monsters in Place[/b] - Monsters are frozen in place and cannot deal damage while time is paused.[/*]
[*][b]Lock Monsters Health[/b] - Monsters cannot lose health while time is paused.[/*]
[*][b]Pause Machine Timers[/b] - Machines and crafting stop processing while time is paused.[/*]
[*][b]Pause Buff Timers[/b] - Food, drink, and other buff durations do not expire while time is paused.[/*]
[*][b]Disable Damage While Paused[/b] - Player health is locked. Damage cannot be taken while paused.[/*]
[*][b]Pause During Events[/b] - Pauses time while any player is in a cutscene or event.[/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Clock Display[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Updates the clock display every in-game minute instead of every 10 minutes.[/*]
[*]Machines and objects process every game minute instead of every 10 minutes, matching the per-minute clock. [color=#b4a7d6](default: on)[/color][/*]
[*][b]Show Pause Indicator[/b] - Shows an X icon on the clock when time is frozen or paused. [color=#b4a7d6](default: on)[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Vote to pause or unpause time. Vote counts and player names are broadcast as notifications.[/*]
[*]Pause notifications update in place instead of stacking, so the latest vote state is always the one shown.[/*]
[*]Vote state and time skip regen multiplier sync from host to all clients.[/*]
[*]Peer connect detection warns on version mismatch or missing mod.[/*]
[*]Split-screen is supported.[/*]
[*]Public API for other mods to query vote state, player count, and tracked player IDs. [u]Used in my other mod:[/u] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48739]Party Info[/url][/*]
[/list][b][size=5]API[/size][/b]
[spoiler]Time Control registers a SMAPI API under the mod ID [font=Consolas]yousv.TimeControl[/font]. Other mods can access it via [font=Consolas]IModRegistry.GetApi[/font].
[list]
[*][b]HasPlayerVotedToPause(long farmerId)[/b] - Returns whether the given player has toggled their pause vote on.[/*]
[*][b]VoteCount[/b] - Number of players currently with yes votes.[/*]
[*][b]TotalPlayers[/b] - Total number of tracked players.[/*]
[*][b]GetTrackedPlayerIds()[/b] - All tracked player unique IDs.[/*]
[/list]Usage example:
[code]
var api = helper.ModRegistry.GetApi<ITimeControlApi>("yousv.TimeControl");
if (api != null)
{
bool voted = api.HasPlayerVotedToPause(someFarmerId);
int paused = api.VoteCount;
}[/code]The API is read-only. External mods can read vote state but cannot send messages or modify Time Control's internal state.[/spoiler]
